captions.caption: A man in a blue shirt is picking up fallen branches in a lush, green forest.
He walks through the dense woods carrying several long sticks over his shoulder.
The man continues his walk deeper into the forest, surrounded by tall trees and ferns.
He navigates through the undergrowth, still holding the bundle of sticks.
He walks past a large tree trunk as he makes his way through the forest.
The man enters a small clearing where he is building a primitive structure.
He drops the load of branches onto a pile of wood on the ground.
After dropping the sticks, he turns around to fetch more materials.
He walks back across the clearing towards the edge of the woods.
The man disappears from the frame as he heads back into the forest.
Now standing by a basic wooden frame, he prepares to add more branches to it.
He adjusts a horizontal branch that is tied between two upright trees.
He takes a moment to inspect the structure he is building in the woods.
He picks up a long, thin branch from the ground near the structure.
He leans the branch vertically against the horizontal support pole.
He grabs another branch and places it next to the first one against the frame.
He continues to add vertical branches to form a wall for his shelter.
He places another stick against the frame, carefully positioning it.
He makes a small adjustment to one of the branches he just added.
He reaches for more wood from a pile located to the right of the frame.
He adds yet another branch to the growing wall of the structure.
He continues the repetitive process of leaning branches against the support.
He steps back slightly to see how the wall is coming together.
He moves a branch a few inches to the side to close a gap.
He picks up a thicker branch from the ground to use in the wall.
He leans the thick branch against the horizontal pole of the structure.
He reaches down and picks up another branch to add to the shelter.
He places the new branch against the frame, continuing to build the wall.
He adjusts the positioning of the branches to ensure they are stable.
He adds another vertical branch, filling in another space in the frame.
He pushes the branches closer together to create a more solid wall.
He looks down at the ground to find more suitable branches.
He bends over and gathers a few more branches from the forest floor.
He picks up two branches that are covered in green moss.
He leans one of the mossy branches against the wooden frame.
He adds the second mossy branch to the structure's wall.
He adjusts the mossy branch to make sure it's leaning securely.
He stands back and looks at the wall he has constructed so far.
He moves to the side of the structure to begin a different task.
In a close-up, he begins weaving a thin, flexible branch through the vertical ones.
He carefully threads the thin branch in front of one stick and behind the next.
He continues the weaving pattern, moving horizontally across the wall.
He pulls the thin branch through the gaps to tighten the structure.
He moves his hands to the next set of vertical branches to continue weaving.
He threads the branch behind another vertical pole in the wall.
He continues to work the thin branch through the structure.
He reaches further along the wall, continuing the horizontal weave.
He carefully guides the end of the branch through a narrow opening.
He pulls the branch all the way through to keep the weave tight.
He proceeds with the weaving, moving from left to right across the frame.
He adjusts the height of the horizontal branch as he weaves it.
He pulls on the branch to ensure there is no slack in the weave.
He finds another spot to thread the branch through the vertical sticks.
He pushes the end of the branch through a gap between two poles.
He completes the weave for this particular flexible branch.
The camera angle shifts to show him starting a new weave lower down.
He begins weaving a fresh branch through the bottom part of the wall.
He threads the new branch through the first few vertical poles.
He pulls the branch through to secure the base of the wall.
He continues the weaving process on the lower section of the structure.
